comments.body:
The ldp:NonRDFSource interaction model constraint is returned on Binary resources:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-http-api/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/http/api/ContentExposingResource.java#L506

To date, we have not really considered non-LDP types as "interaction models"... but maybe that should be reconsidered.
I will leave this ticket in the "Received" state, pending more discussion.
OK. This feels redundant, but I do want to point out that the spec appears to label these "interaction models."  See the links in the description.

Specifically, this calls out:
```
A versioned resource (LDPRv) provides a TimeGate interaction model as detailed in the Memento specification ...
```
https://fcrepo.github.io/fcrepo-specification/#ldprv
Pending response to code review comments... and possible inclusion of kefo text.
I inserted kefo's text in the constraints document.

renderedFields.description:
The current constrainedBy document mentions three interaction models: BasicContainer, DirectContainer, and IndirectContainer.  It also contains verbiage about how the software goes about determining the default interaction model (based on content-type).

Reading the nascent Fedora spec, I see two additional interaction models mentioned: ldp:NonRDFSource and memento:OriginalResource  . 

Shouldn't these be added?
